git.tip.state.defaultMessage: Git is {state, select, merge {merging} rebase {rebasing} cherrypick {cherry-picking} revert {reverting} other {bisecting}}: finish or abort it in a terminal.
git.tip.state.description: The status bar's git tooltip, while git has an operation in progress in the project folder.

git.tip.tracks.defaultMessage: Tracks {upstream}: {ahead, plural, =0 {nothing} one {# commit} other {# commits}} to push, {behind, plural, =0 {nothing} one {# commit} other {# commits}} to pull.
git.tip.tracks.description: The status bar's git tooltip. {upstream} is the remote branch, such as origin/main; the counts are as of the last fetch.

git.tool.fixMissing.defaultMessage: Install Git for Windows ({min} or later), or add the folder holding git.exe to your PATH, then Check again in Agent Setup (no need to restart Hive).
git.tool.fixMissing.description: How to fix git missing. {min} is a git version; Check again is a button in Agent Setup.

git.tool.fixOld.defaultMessage: Update Git for Windows to {min} or later, then Check again in Agent Setup.
git.tool.fixOld.description: How to fix a git that is too old. {min} is a git version; Check again is a button in Agent Setup.

git.tool.missing.defaultMessage: Git isn't installed (or isn't on Hive's PATH)
git.tool.missing.description: Said wherever git is needed when Hive cannot run git. No full stop: some places add more after it.

git.tool.oldLoses.defaultMessage: {lost, select, recent {With Git {version}: merging can't check for conflicts before it starts (the merge still stops at one); squash-merged branches still count as unmerged, so Remove All and loading a template keep their worktrees; the merge-ready skill can't check a branch for conflicts.} older {With Git {version}: merging can't check for conflicts before it starts (the merge still stops at one); squash-merged branches still count as unmerged, so Remove All and loading a template keep their worktrees; the merge-ready skill can't check a branch for conflicts; moving a workspace can't repair its worktrees.} other {With Git {version}: merging can't check for conflicts before it starts (the merge still stops at one); squash-merged branches still count as unmerged, so Remove All and loading a template keep their worktrees; the merge-ready skill can't check a branch for conflicts; Remove All and loading a template keep the branches of the worktrees they remove; moving a workspace can't repair its worktrees.}}
git.tool.oldLoses.description: Agent Setup: what does not work with an older git that still runs. {version} is its version; {lost} says how old it is (the older, the more is listed). Remove All and merge-ready are names in Hive.

git.tool.tooOld.defaultMessage: Git {version} is too old for Hive (it needs {min} or later)
git.tool.tooOld.description: Said wherever git is needed when the installed git is too old to run. {version} and {min} are git versions. No full stop: some places add more after it.

git.tool.tooOldToRun.defaultMessage: Hive's git commands fail with Git {version}: worktrees, merging, the Git tab and the unmerged counts don't work.
git.tool.tooOldToRun.description: Agent Setup, for a git too old for any of Hive's git commands. {version} is its version.

git.upstream.gone.description: In place of the ahead/behind counts: the remote branch a branch tracked was deleted on the remote.

git.validate.enterName.description: Under a form's name box (a remote, a branch, a tag) while it is empty.

git.validate.enterUrl.description: Under a remote's URL box while it is empty.

git.validate.nameLine.defaultMessage: A name is one line, without < or >
git.validate.nameLine.description: Under a commit identity form when the name has a line break, < or >.

git.validate.notUrl.defaultMessage: That isn't a URL or path

git.validate.remoteName.description: Under Add a remote's name box when the name has other characters.

git.validate.wholeUrl.defaultMessage: Type the whole URL: its password or token is hidden here
git.validate.wholeUrl.description: Under a remote's URL box when it still has ••• for a hidden password.

git.worktree.agent.description: A worktree that belongs to an agent. {agent} is the agent's name.

git.worktree.badge.description: Badge on a branch checked out in a worktree that isn't an agent's.

git.worktree.unused.description: A worktree of the repository that belongs to no agent.

git.worktrees.changes.description: Button on a worktree's row: shows its changes in Git → Changes.

git.worktrees.heading.description: Heading in Git → Branches & remotes, followed by how many there are.

git.worktrees.readOnly.defaultMessage: Read-only here: an agent's work comes into the project folder through Merge.
git.worktrees.readOnly.description: Under the Worktrees heading. Merge is the name of the action that brings an agent's branch in.
